comment: Dystopo data source registry (docs/PLANNING.md > Licensing, hard rule 4). Every data source used to build anything we ship is listed here with its license and required attribution. Outputs compose their attribution from this file through SourceRegistry; don't hard-code credits elsewhere. kind: dem | geoid | osm (inputs to the OSM vector tile build) | overlay | font (fonts the app draws labels with). license is an SPDX id or expression (ids joined with AND / OR / WITH), or LicenseRef-* where SPDX has none.

sources.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public
sources.provider: European Union / ESA (Copernicus Programme); WorldDEM by DLR and Airbus; hosted on AWS Open Data by Sinergise

coverage.summary: Global land, except a small set of GLO-30 tiles not released to the public; no tiles over open ocean.

sources.licenseName: Copernicus DEM licence (free for the general public)
sources.attribution: Elevation: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
sources.attributionHtml: Elevation: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
sources.allowedUses: Free use, modification and redistribution of derived products (including commercial) with the required credit.
sources.updateCadence: Static (2021 release); the public tile list can change.
sources.notes: Surface model (DSM): includes forest canopy and buildings, so it sits above bare-earth DEMs in forest. 1x1 degree Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs named by their south-west corner.

sources.name: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second DEM
sources.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program (The National Map)

coverage.summary: Conterminous US, Hawaii, US territories and parts of Alaska; seamless.

sources.attribution: Elevation: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) 1/3 arc-second DEM, courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey (public domain).
sources.attributionHtml: Elevation: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second DEM, courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey (public domain).
sources.allowedUses: Unrestricted. USGS asks that it be credited as the source.
sources.updateCadence: Rolling: cells are refreshed in 'current' as new lidar is incorporated, several times a year.
sources.notes: 1x1 degree Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs named by their north-west corner, NAD83 geographic. Converted to EGM2008 with the hybrid geoid covering each cell (geoid18 in CONUS, geoid18-prvi in Puerto Rico / USVI, geoid12b-alaska, geoid12b-hawaii) and egm2008; not fetched where no hybrid geoid covers.

sources.name: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar DEM
sources.provider: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program (The National Map)

coverage.summary: Patchy, project by project, across the US; growing. Found through the TNM Access API.

sources.attribution: Elevation: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) 1 m lidar DEM, courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey (public domain).
sources.attributionHtml: Elevation: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar DEM, courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey (public domain).
sources.allowedUses: Unrestricted. USGS asks that it be credited as the source.
sources.updateCadence: Continuous: new lidar projects are published as surveys are processed.
sources.notes: 10x10 km tiles in NAD83 / UTM, grouped by survey project; newer surveys are composited on top. Bare earth. Converted to EGM2008 with the hybrid geoid covering each cell (geoid18, geoid18-prvi, geoid12b-alaska, geoid12b-hawaii) and egm2008.

sources.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles (Terrarium, legacy)
sources.provider: Mapzen / Tilezen joerd, hosted on AWS Open Data

coverage.summary: Global, z0-15 Web Mercator tiles; a frozen ~2017 mosaic of many national and global datasets.

sources.resolution: Varies by underlying dataset: ~3-10 m in parts of the US and Europe, 30-90 m elsewhere; tiles up to z15
sources.verticalDatum: Mixed (each underlying dataset's own datum; not converted)
sources.licenseName: Mixed open licenses of the underlying datasets (public domain, CC BY 4.0, OGL and others)
sources.attribution: Elevation: Mapzen Terrain Tiles. sources.allowedUses: Comparison only in Dystopo. Redistribution requires the full per-provider credit list; check each provider's terms.
sources.notes: Legacy: kept in devtool only to compare against. Not used in shipped outputs. Attribution is joerd's full provider list; tiles in a given area use only some of them.

sources.name: NGS GEOID18
sources.provider: NOAA National Geodetic Survey; grid converted to GeoTIFF by the PROJ-data project

coverage.summary: Conterminous US (this grid; Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands are geoid18-prvi).

sources.verticalDatum: NAVD88 relative to the NAD83(2011) ellipsoid
sources.attribution: Geoid: NGS GEOID18, courtesy of NOAA National Geodetic Survey (public domain), via PROJ-data.
sources.attributionHtml: Geoid: NGS GEOID18, courtesy of NOAA National Geodetic Survey (public domain), via PROJ-data.
sources.updateCadence: Static; to be superseded by GEOID2022 when NGS releases the modernized NSRS (NAPGD2022).
sources.notes: Used with egm2008 to convert NAVD88 heights (USGS DEMs) to EGM2008.

sources.name: NGS GEOID18 (Puerto Rico and US Virgin Islands)
sources.provider: NOAA National Geodetic Survey; grid converted to GeoTIFF by the PROJ-data project

coverage.summary: Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands.

sources.verticalDatum: PRVD02 / VIVD09 relative to the NAD83(2011) ellipsoid
sources.attribution: Geoid: NGS GEOID18, courtesy of NOAA National Geodetic Survey (public domain), via PROJ-data.
sources.attributionHtml: Geoid: NGS GEOID18, courtesy of NOAA National Geodetic Survey (public domain), via PROJ-data.
sources.updateCadence: Static; to be superseded by GEOID2022 when NGS releases the modernized NSRS (NAPGD2022).
sources.notes: Supersedes GEOID12B (us_noaa_g2012bp0) in Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands. Used with egm2008 to convert PRVD02 / VIVD09 heights (USGS DEMs) to EGM2008.

sources.name: NGS GEOID12B (Alaska)
sources.provider: NOAA National Geodetic Survey; grid converted to GeoTIFF by the PROJ-data project

coverage.summary: Alaska: 49-72 N, 172 E eastward across the antimeridian to 126 W (so no bbox here).

sources.verticalDatum: NAVD88 relative to the NAD83(2011) ellipsoid
sources.attribution: Geoid: NGS GEOID12B, courtesy of NOAA National Geodetic Survey (public domain), via PROJ-data.
sources.attributionHtml: Geoid: NGS GEOID12B, courtesy of NOAA National Geodetic Survey (public domain), via PROJ-data.
sources.updateCadence: Static; GEOID18 does not cover Alaska, so NGS keeps GEOID12B there until GEOID2022.
sources.notes: Used with egm2008 to convert Alaska NAVD88 heights (USGS DEMs) to EGM2008.

sources.name: NGS GEOID12B (Hawaii)
sources.provider: NOAA National Geodetic Survey; grid converted to GeoTIFF by the PROJ-data project
sources.verticalDatum: USGG2012-based local datum (offset 50-60 cm from some local tidal bench marks) relative to the NAD83(PA11) ellipsoid
sources.attribution: Geoid: NGS GEOID12B, courtesy of NOAA National Geodetic Survey (public domain), via PROJ-data.
sources.attributionHtml: Geoid: NGS GEOID12B, courtesy of NOAA National Geodetic Survey (public domain), via PROJ-data.
sources.updateCadence: Static; GEOID18 does not cover Hawaii, so NGS keeps GEOID12B there until GEOID2022.
sources.notes: Referenced to NAD83(PA11), not NAD83(2011); the ellipsoid shift to WGS84 uses the PA11 translation. Used with egm2008 to convert Hawaii heights (USGS DEMs) to EGM2008.

sources.name: NGA EGM2008 geoid (2.5 arc-minute grid)
sources.provider: U.S. National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency; grid built with GeographicLib and converted by the PROJ-data project
sources.verticalDatum: EGM2008 relative to the WGS84 ellipsoid
sources.attribution: Geoid: EGM2008, courtesy of the U.S. National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (public domain), via PROJ-data.
sources.attributionHtml: Geoid: EGM2008, courtesy of the U.S. National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (public domain), via PROJ-data.
sources.notes: EGM2008 is Dystopo's internal vertical datum; every source converts to it.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.provider: OpenStreetMap contributors (OpenStreetMap Foundation); regional extracts from Geofabrik
sources.allowedUses: Any use, including commercial. Derived databases (our vector tiles) must stay ODbL; produced works must carry the attribution.
sources.updateCadence: Continuous edits; Geofabrik extracts are rebuilt daily.
sources.notes: Tile archives built from it are ODbL derived databases.

sources.name: OSM water polygons
sources.notes: Planetiler aux input for the ocean layer. Credit is the same as OSM's, so composed attribution shows it once.

sources.name: OSM lake centerlines
sources.provider: OpenMapTiles (osm-lakelines), derived from OpenStreetMap; file hosted by MapTiler

coverage.summary: Global lakes large enough to label.

sources.notes: Planetiler aux input for lake label lines. Downloaded from MapTiler's dev.maptiler.download server (the URL Planetiler's OpenMapTiles profile uses), not from an OSM or OpenMapTiles release; if that URL goes away the build needs a new mirror. The data stays ODbL either way.

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.provider: Natural Earth (naturalearthdata.com), packaged as SQLite by OpenMapTiles; file hosted by MapTiler

coverage.summary: Global; small-scale (1:10m to 1:110m) cultural and physical vectors.

sources.allowedUses: Unrestricted; credit is optional (Natural Earth suggests 'Made with Natural Earth').
sources.notes: Used by the OSM tile build (OpenMapTiles profile) for low-zoom boundaries, landcover and labels.

sources.name: OpenMapTiles schema

coverage.summary: Not geographic: the vector tile schema (layers and attributes) our OSM tiles follow.

sources.allowedUses: Any use with the visible '© OpenMapTiles' credit (CC-BY 4.0 design license).
sources.notes: Planetiler's OpenMapTiles profile implements this schema.

sources.name: Noto Sans (map label glyphs)
sources.provider: The Noto Project Authors (Google); glyph PBF ranges from Protomaps basemaps-assets

coverage.summary: Not geographic: the font MapLibre draws map labels with (Noto Sans Regular, Italic and Medium).

sources.attribution: Labels: Noto Sans, © The Noto Project Authors (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
sources.attributionHtml: Labels: Noto Sans, © The Noto Project Authors (SIL OFL 1.1).
sources.allowedUses: Use, embedding and redistribution, including in commercial apps, with the copyright notice and license; the font may not be sold by itself; modified versions may not use the reserved font name.
sources.updateCadence: Static; fetched once into the cache by tools/android-push-pack.ps1 and pushed with the packs.
sources.notes: MapLibre loads label glyphs as signed-distance-field PBF ranges (0-255 ... 65280-65535) per font stack. The PBFs are generated from the Noto Sans TTFs, so the font's OFL applies to them.
